response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd

assumptions.assumption: AVG(length) ignores NULL lengths automatically, so each rating's average length uses only films with a length. The per-day price averages over all of the rating's films, because rental_rate and rental_duration are NOT NULL.
Ratings with NULL rating (if any) form their own group and count as a rating in the cross-rating mean. The verified data shows exactly 5 ratings, so this should not matter.
